title: Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Juniper is a startup building banking apps. We are looking for a mid-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Northhaven office.

Our stack: kotlin, swift. You will review code with the team, work closely with design and product and own the release process.

Modern devices for testing.
